bio.text: Lori Trahan represents Massachusetts's 3rd Congressional District in the U.S. House of Representatives and serves on the Energy and Commerce Committee.
Her hometown is Lowell; she graduated from Lowell High School and was the first in her family to graduate from college, at Georgetown University.
She worked on Rep. Marty Meehan's staff, rising to chief of staff, then was an executive at a tech company and co-founded a consulting firm before first running for office in 2018.
